Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring lottery advertisements to include education funding levels.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to lottery advertisements; and adding a new sectionto chapter 67.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any broadcast, print media, or written advertising on behalf ofthe state lottery must include the following statement in thecommunication: "Lottery proceeds fund education at a level less thanone percent of the total state budget." (2) With respect to broadcast media advertising on behalf of thestate lottery, the statement required by subsection (1) of this sectionshall be clearly stated on any broadcast advertisement. (3) With respect to print media or written advertising on behalf ofthe state lottery, the statement required by subsection (1) of thissection shall: (a) Appear on the first page or fold of print media or writtenadvertising in at least ten-point type, or in type that is at least tenpercent of the largest size type used in the written communication,whichever is larger; p. 1 HB 2243 (b) Not be subject to the half-tone or screening process; and (c) Be set apart from any other printed matter.
